gap: No result ChatGPT got puts the makers' battery ratings on one basis: in eight-hour workdays with the backlight on, the Lofree Flow 2 84 lasts about 2 (13 to 17 h), the NuPhy Air75 V3 7.5 to 12.5 (60 to 100 h), the Logitech MX Mechanical Mini is rated only in days (15) with no hours-per-day stated, and the Keychron K3 Max has only one unlit-class figure (73 h, about 9 workdays).
standout_why: Compared against mechkeyfoundry (both pages), mkbguide low-profile, techwisereviews and the RTINGS low-profile page (RTINGS returned only navigation to the fetcher, so its body was not compared). Mechkeyfoundry and mkbguide already print the raw figures: 1,200 h / 60-100 h for the Air75 V3, 120 h / 17 h for the Flow 2, 15 days / 10 months for the Logitech, plus travel, mAh and polling. Techwise has the K3 Max's 73 h. What they lack is the conversion to one unit, the implied current draw per mAh, and the K3 Max figure on mechkeyfoundry, which says Keychron publishes no hours while Keychron's store says 'up to 73 hours'. The height normalisation that would have been new (front edge vs tallest point with keycaps) could not be sourced from maker pages today: the NuPhy and Lofree product pages returned HTTP 429 and Logitech's spec block came back empty.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. The Air75 V3 keeps 'best overall' for anyone typing wirelessly with the backlight on. The Lofree Flow 2 84 for Mac places as the premium-feel pick, with an honest condition: about two workdays per charge lit, about 15 workdays unlit over Bluetooth, so it suits a desk where the backlight is off or a cable is near. The K3 Max is the value pick at $72.49 on Keychron's store today, below both prices ChatGPT showed ($87.49 and $109.99); the variant behind $72.49 was not confirmed.

findings.value: Air75 V3: 7.5-12.5 / 150 workdays, about 3.3 mA. Flow 2 84: about 2 / 15 workdays, 25 mA. K3 Max: no lit figure / about 9 workdays, about 21 mA. Flow Lite 2 84: no lit figure / 12.5 workdays. MX Mechanical Mini for Mac: 15 days / 10 months, hours per day unstated.
findings.source_title: NuPhy Air75 V3 vs Lofree Flow 2 vs Keychron K3 Max, MechKeyFoundry
findings.note: Arithmetic on the ratings sourced in the rows above; this rival page is cited as the place the raw figures sit unconverted, and where the K3 Max is listed with 'no hour figure published'. The footnote is the finding: the Flow 2 and K3 Max unlit ratings imply the same class of draw (25 and 21 mA), so their gap is battery size (3,000 vs 1,550 mAh), while NuPhy's 1,200 h implies a draw about seven times lower and is a lab figure on a different basis. Lit, the Air75 V3 rating is roughly four to seven times the Flow 2's. These are maker ratings, not measurements.
